title: Require task contracts for code-changing pull requests
context: The Agent Task Contract workflow currently runs only when task/config paths change and treats a code-changing PR without a task contract as passing. PR #391 exposed this gap: app source changed without a contract and the contract gate did not run.
goal: Run the contract workflow on every pull request and fail code, test, configuration, or workflow changes that do not include exactly one validated and scope-checked active task contract.
forbidden_changes: Do not change application/runtime behavior or grant new capabilities.
Do not weaken task schema validation or diff scope checks.
Allow narrowly defined documentation-only PRs without a task contract.
acceptance_criteria: Agent Task Contract workflow triggers for every pull request regardless of changed paths.
Non-documentation changes without a task contract fail the workflow.
A pull request changing multiple active task contracts fails with a clear diagnostic.
Exactly one task contract is validated and checked against the PR diff.
Documentation-only PRs remain eligible to pass without a task contract.
verification: Agent Task Contract workflow on this PR
Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA workflow
Review the no-contract and multiple-contract shell branches
recovery: Revert the single task commit if legitimate code PRs are blocked or the workflow stops validating task scope.
